---
title: "Explorer"
---

SMexplorer is a Shiny app that allows for interactive exploration of metrics, mostly at the county level. It includes a map page, a bivariate plot explorer to see relations between metrics, a county/state details page, and a metadata table much like what is included in this Quarto doc. You can find the code at the [SMexplorer GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Food-Systems-Research-Institute/SMexplorer). It tends to work best if you open it in its own page using the button below:

```{r echo=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(
    shiny,
    htmltools
)

tagList(
    tags$div(
        style = "display: flex; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; justify-content: center;",
        tags$a(
            href = "https://fsrc.w3.uvm.edu/SMexplorer/", 
            tags$button(
                "Go To SMexplorer",
                class = 'btn btn-primary',
            target = '_blank'
            )
        )
    )
)
```

You can also just use it here in the window, but some features, like the full screen mode in the map page, will only work in a separate tab. Note that either way, there is a bit of a cold start-up time before the app gets running and becomes responsive.
